jobs.title: Training Specialist (HOA & COA Management)
jobs.description:
Description:
**Training Specialist**

**Company:** Cusick Community Management  

**Location:** Charlotte, NC  

**Work Arrangement:** Primarily in\-office, with a minimum of three days per week. Full in\-office presence is expected during new hire onboarding weeks and major program rollouts.  

**Reports To:** President  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried

**Position Summary**


Cusick Community Management is seeking an experienced and highly organized **Training Specialist** to own and lead the company's employee training, onboarding, systems education, program rollouts, and board training initiatives.


This position will play a key role in ensuring employees have the knowledge, resources, and tools necessary to be successful in their roles. The Training Specialist will oversee the new hire experience from onboarding through the ramp period, develop training materials and programs, provide systems training, and serve as a subject matter expert for key platforms including CINC, HOAce, AvidXchange, and Vonage.


The Training Specialist will also work closely with the President and Regional Directors on company\-wide initiatives and will lead the initial training and rollout of new programs, processes, and systems. This position will also be responsible for providing training to boards of directors for communities transitioning to Cusick Community Management.

**Essential Responsibilities**

### **Employee Onboarding**

* Own the new hire experience from the employee's first day through completion of the onboarding and ramp period.
* Coordinate department\-specific onboarding with department leaders and provide training directly when appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and update onboarding plans for each position.
* Ensure training materials remain current as company processes and procedures evolve.
* Administer competency checks to ensure new hires understand their responsibilities and can effectively perform their jobs before completing onboarding.

### **Systems Training \& Expertise**

* Serve as the internal training expert and first point of escalation for CINC, HOAce, AvidXchange, and Vonage.
* Develop and maintain role\-specific training curriculums for each platform.
* Ensure employees understand how systems should be used based on their specific responsibilities.
* Maintain consistency in how systems are configured and utilized across communities and departments.
* Evaluate new system releases and features and determine their impact and applicability to Cusick.
* Lead training and adoption of applicable system updates and enhancements.
* Coordinate user setup and permissions with system owners.
* Ensure system access is properly provisioned during onboarding and revoked during employee offboarding.

### **Program Launch \& Implementation**

* Design and deliver the initial training for new programs, processes, and system changes.
* Develop training materials, presentations, job aids, and competency assessments for new initiatives.
* Work directly with the President regarding company\-wide rollout priorities and timing.
* Prepare Regional Directors and other leaders to reinforce new programs after the initial implementation.
* Monitor adoption following implementation and identify areas requiring additional training or reinforcement.
* Return to provide additional training when programs or processes are not being consistently adopted.

### **Ongoing Training \& Development**

* Develop and maintain an ongoing training plan to ensure employees remain current as systems, statutes, and company processes change.
* Maintain training materials, study guides, reference materials, and job aids across departments.
* Meet regularly with Regional Directors and department supervisors to identify training gaps and areas where employees may need additional support.
* Develop targeted training programs when a recurring issue requires structured instruction rather than one\-on\-one coaching.
* Confirm employee understanding and competency following targeted training.
* Identify recurring issues across multiple employees and escalate patterns to leadership when they may indicate a larger process or operational issue.

### **Board Training**

* Provide onboarding and training for every new board transitioning to Cusick Community Management.
* Train board members on CINC portal functionality and clarify the respective responsibilities of the board and management company.
* Maintain and update board training materials and curriculum.
* Provide boards with reference materials they can utilize following training sessions.
* Conduct annual refresher training following board elections to account for board member turnover.
* Coordinate with the Community Association Manager and Regional Director to ensure board training is tailored to the specific community.
* Maintain accurate records of which communities have completed board training and when training occurred.

### **Employee Offboarding**

* Own and coordinate the employee offboarding process in partnership with supervisors, HR, and IT.
* Complete the company's offboarding checklist, including same\-day system access revocation.
* Coordinate equipment returns and required documentation.
* Ensure departing employees acknowledge applicable confidentiality and restrictive covenant obligations.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer and account reassignment with the employee's supervisor.
* Maintain complete and accurate offboarding documentation.


Requirements:
**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in training, learning and development, or a supervisory position with significant training responsibilities.
* Community association management experience is preferred.
* Experience with **CINC Systems** is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AvidXchange, Vonage or comparable VoIP systems, and AI\-assisted workflow tools is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build training programs and materials from the ground up.
* Strong ability to understand and communicate technical information across multiple departments.
* Excellent presentation and facilitation skills with both individuals and groups.
* Comfortable delivering training in person as well as virtually.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, supervisors, leadership, and client\-facing audiences.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to exercise discretion and sound judgment when handling employee offboarding and performance\-related training matters.

**What Success Looks Like: Success in this position will be measured by:**

* Reduced time to productivity for new hires.
* Successful completion of employee competency checks.
* Strong adoption of new systems, programs, and processes.
* Reduction in repeat errors and escalations involving trained responsibilities.
* Completion of board training for transitioning communities within established timelines.
* Consistent annual board refresher training.
* Accurate and timely completion of employee offboarding requirements.
* Positive feedback from supervisors and Regional Directors regarding training effectiveness and responsiveness.

**About Cusick Community Management**

  

Cusick Community Management is a division of Summit Management Partners serving more than 300 communities throughout the Carolinas. The company operates from offices in **Charlotte, Rock Hill, and Raleigh** and provides community association management services to communities throughout the region.

jobs.title: HIS Implementation Consultant (New Health Care Company)
jobs.description:
Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum. Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum, people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue. Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding. Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/legal/website\-privacy\-statement/applicant\-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit. As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
**Job Description:**

**Implementation Consultant** **(Solventum)**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game\-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

By applying to this position, you acknowledge that Solventum recently publicly announced its intention to divest its Health Information Systems Business. See Solventum Announces Intent to Separate its Health Information Systems Business :: Solventum Corporation Newsroom . No decision has been made regarding the ultimate structure or timing of any potential transaction, and there can be no assurance that a separation will occur. Any transaction would be subject to customary approvals, including approval by Solventum's Board of Directors, regulatory requirements and other customary conditions. This position supports the Health Information Systems Business. If a future transaction involving that business were to occur, the impact on this role would be determined as part of that process and would remain subject to applicable legal requirements, approvals and business decisions.


**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**  

As an Implementation consultant, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:


* Collaborating with clients and internal team members to complete the project deliverables and implementation needs.
* Assessing current state workflow and work with implementation team to validate proposed future state fits with overall project objectives.
* Leading and working interactively with clients and team members to configure, test and validate the application environment.
* Leading issue resolution: communicating with client and internal teams on issue resolution and configuration change, tracking and documenting issues encountered.
* Performing problem isolation/analysis of issues, partner with support and escalations team in root cause analysis and troubleshooting.
* Training system administrators and end users
* Leading testing and go\-live support. Interacting with customer's team on issue resolution and configuration changes.
* Keeping up to date with all new features, functions, business issues and implementation options. And contributing to the evolutionary growth of implementation infrastructure by developing and/or updating material, tools and programs.

**Your Skills and Expertise**  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


* Bachelor’s Degree or higher and three (3\) combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting)

OR


* High School Diploma/GED or higher from an accredited institution and 7 years combined years direct experience with support of software and/or implementation of software (preferably in a healthcare setting)

AND


In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:


* Minimum of two (2\) combined years of working knowledge of hospital and/or professional healthcare coding workflow
* Minimum of two (2\) year' experience in a client facing implementation role
* Ability to travel
* Must be able to complete a Government background check for a position of T3 Public Trust

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:


* Knowledge of 3M/Solventum HIS products
* Electronic Medical Record implementation experience
* Ability to solve problems in a logical, methodical, and time efficient manner
* Must be self\-starter with ability to analyze and critically think. Excellent problem solving and organizational skills.
* Strong written/verbal communication skills and must be capable of maintaining superior customer relations in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to quickly learn and apply new tools and technology

**Work location:**

* **Remote**

**Travel: May include up to 25%**

**Relocation Assistance: Not authorized**

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well\-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.


Onboarding Requirement: To improve the onboarding experience, you will have an opportunity to meet with your manager and other new employees as part of the Solventum new employee orientation. As a result, new employees hired for this position will be required to travel to a designated company location for on\-site onboarding during their initial days of employment. Travel arrangements and related expenses will be coordinated and paid for by the company in accordance with its travel policy. Applies to new hires with a start date of October 1st 2025 or later.
Applicable to US Applicants Only:The expected compensation range for this position is $96,000 \- $132,000, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience. In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental \& Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care \& Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.). Additional information is available at: https://www.solventum.com/en\-us/home/our\-company/careers/\#Total\-Rewards  

Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.
Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.


Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.


Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.
Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1\) uploading a resume, or 2\) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

**Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**

  

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.


Please access the linked document by clicking here . Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Validation Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview:

We have an exciting ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** opportunity for an experienced professional to join our team at Pediatrix Medical Group. We are a national organization, and one of the nation’s largest providers of prenatal, neonatal and pediatric services.  

Talented business professionals from diverse backgrounds choose Pediatrix because we are an exciting and innovative company that focuses on a team approach to improve the lives of patients everywhere. We offer a diverse range of opportunities, competitive salaries and benefits, and a commitment to clinical excellence, we are confident that ***you'll love being a part of the Pediatrix team.***
Responsibilities:

The ***Sr Clinical Systems Validation Specialist*** will facilitate and support development, testing, and education for the clinical information systems. This position will serve as a technical resource for these projects. Consult clinical personnel as needed regarding clinical issues related to Clinical Information Systems. Responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining test scripts that ensure exhaustive testing of clinical information systems to ensure compliance with system specifications.  

* Tests and evaluates all new versions of the Clinical Information Systems before implementation at beta sites. Follow testing plan as designed.
* Interpret user problems and suggest appropriate system change proposals to correct issues and to enhance system functionality and performance.
* Executes functional, application, regression, and performance tests for new version releases.
* Makes on\-site visits to enhance beta testing on updated versions of the Clinical Information System. Annual review and update of the testing plan.
* Performs and facilitates research and testing, provide overall project leadership to ensure hospital and Physician client interfaces conform to the client's HL7 standards.
* Expedites all incoming questions/problems generated by the physicians regarding clinical information systems and facilitates resolutions.
* Screens and prioritizes all requests and implements in an efficient and timely manner.  

Review and update all Q/A items in JIRA related to production open, current build and specific projects.
* Collaborates with all departments to resolve issues in a professional and timely manner.  

Provides prompt, courteous, professional, and accurate information in all communications in dealing with physicians and other departments.
* Demonstrates a commitment to department objectives through consistent patterns of work behavior and positive representation.
* Responds to the department needs by accepting additional assignments, which may or may not be related to the job’s primary responsibilities to ensure the continuity of department services.
* Responsible for following all facility, organization and department precautions and procedures in the performance of all job duties to ensure a safe work environment for self and others.
* Stays current with HIPAA guidelines and ensures that the Clinical Information Systems are compliant with these guidelines.
* Ability to work flexible schedules, including night shifts and on call rotations
* Ability to work independently and demonstrate initiative and problem\-solving skills within a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment
* Effective prioritization skills and the ability to execute tasks high paced, deadline\-driven environment with the ability to multitask.


Qualifications:
***Education/Experience:**** Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 3\-5 years as a Quality Assurance Analyst or Product Support Analyst in a healthcare setting preferred.
* Experience with test planning, design and metrics, as well as working knowledge of product development cycle, testing process, and formal testing methodologies.
* Experience with EMR / EHR interfaces and implementation.
* Experience with HL7 interfaces.

 ***Knowledge/Skills:**** Excellent analysis and trouble\-shooting skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to the specific needs as required.
* Some understanding of the NICU or Office Based setting and its functions is preferred.
* Proficient working knowledge of change management (defect, enhancement, new feature) tracking and source/version control systems.
* Ability to understand HL7 standards.
* Familiarity with a commercial Integration Engine Product a plus.

 ***Software:**** Experience in Microsoft Office, Email, and Windows. Working knowledge of quality assurance process and methodologies.
* Some knowledge of Visual Basic, automated testing tools and relational databases such as SQL preferred.


Benefits and Compensation:
***Take great care of the patient, every day and every way.TM*** At Pediatrix \& Obstetrix, that’s not only our motto at work each day; it’s also how we view our employees and their families. We know that our greatest asset is YOU.  

We take pride in offering comprehensive benefits in a vast array of plans that fit your life and lifestyle, supporting your health and overall well\-being. Benefits offered include, but are not limited to: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Healthcare FSA, Dependent Care FSA and HSAs, as well as a 401k plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program. Some benefits are provided at no cost, while others require a cost share between employees and the company. Employees may also select voluntary plans and pay for these benefits through convenient payroll deductions. Our benefit programs are just one of the many ways Pediatrix \& Obstetrix helps our employees take care of themselves and their families.
About Us:  

Pediatrix Medical Group is one of the nation’s leading providers of highly specialized health care for women, babies and children. Since 1979, Pediatrix has grown from a single neonatology practice to a national, multispecialty medical group. Pediatrix\-affiliated clinicians are committed to providing coordinated, compassionate and clinically excellent services to women, babies and children across the continuum of care, both in hospital settings and office\-based practices. The group’s high\-quality, evidence\-based care is bolstered by significant investments in research, education, quality\-improvement and safety initiatives. *Please Note: Fraudulent job postings/job scams are becoming increasingly common. All genuine Pediatrix job postings can be found through the Pediatrix Careers site:* *www.pediatrix.com/careers**.**\#LI\-Remote*
Pediatrix is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Specialist, Praxis Health
jobs.description:
We're looking for a **Clinical Systems Specialist** to handle the day to day technical and operational work that keeps the technology across Praxis Health clinics running for providers and clinic staff, the EHR and the systems around it: user account provisioning, EPCS, provider schedule updates, and troubleshooting. This is hands on, execution focused work, not project management or training.



The role also owns day to day coordination of the Oracle relationship as it relates to new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management. This role is responsible for managing the operational coordination required to support the Oracle relationship, ensuring smooth, effective interaction and alignment with strategic initiatives.



The role reports to the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations and RLCMs when an issue affects a specific clinic or provider, and works closely with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle updates.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Remote for Oregon and Washington residents only


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts across clinical systems in line with onboarding, role change, and offboarding requests.
* Manage Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) enrollment, identity proofing coordination, and ongoing account maintenance for providers.
* Process and maintain provider schedule updates in the relevant clinical systems.
* Provide initial troubleshooting support for clinic staff and providers on account access, system errors, and basic system functionality; escalate issues beyond this scope to the appropriate technical owner.
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact with Oracle for new products, system updates, and Service Request (SR) creation and management; escalate strategic or contractual matters to the Director of Digital Transformation.
* Work with Operations to define and maintain clinical workflows and workflow changes driven by Oracle system updates.
* Partner with the Clinical Systems Training Specialists to flag workflow and technology changes that require staff education or training, so updates are communicated and adopted smoothly.
* Support change management for clinical systems initiatives and ensure changes are implemented in line with relevant Praxis Health policies and procedures.
* Champion innovative uses of technology that advance Praxis Health's strategic goals, looking beyond day\-to\-day maintenance to how clinical systems can move the organization forward.
* Maintain accurate records of account and access changes for audit and compliance purposes.
* Flag recurring issues or patterns to the Clinical Systems Manager rather than solving the same problem repeatedly in isolation.
* Support go\-live and cutover activities for the Oracle Health EHR implementation as needed, including account setup and access verification ahead of go\-live.
* Provide provisioning, troubleshooting, and workflow support across the full clinic technology stack, including the EHR, patient registration, document management, and bolt\-on vendor platforms, not the EHR alone.
* Support evaluation, rollout, and troubleshooting of AI\-enabled clinic tools such as ambient documentation and AI scribes as they are adopted.


**What You Bring:**


* Clinical background (nursing, allied health, or clinical operations) or a degree/certification in clinical informatics, health informatics, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of clinical workflows and how they translate into system requirements, configuration, and downstream impact on clinical staff and providers.
* Able to bridge clinical and technical perspectives, translating clinical needs into system changes, and system or workflow changes into plain terms for clinical staff.
* Comfortable with detail\-heavy, process\-driven work where accuracy and compliance matter.
* Curious and forward\-looking about technology; interested in more than keeping systems running, and in finding better ways to support Praxis Health's goals.
* Clear, patient communication style for working directly with clinical staff and providers who may not be technical.
* Experience working directly with an EHR vendor on support tickets, system updates, or product rollouts.
* Able to troubleshoot common clinical system and access issues and know when to escalate rather than guess.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with EHR or clinical system administration, including user account management and access provisioning.
* Familiarity with EPCS requirements and identity proofing processes.
* Familiarity with adjacent front\-office and revenue cycle processes such as patient registration, inbound document management, and basic billing/coding concepts.
* Exposure to AI tools in a healthcare setting; experience with AI scribes or ambient documentation a plus.


**About Our Company**



Praxis Health is a family of medical groups providing high\-quality healthcare throughout the state of Oregon. Our community\-based clinics are the DNA of our business, providing better medicine, advocacy for our patients, and a satisfying and collaborative culture for our providers and staff. The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. We are not "big box" health care, but rather a company of small groups and clinics, of nimble micro\-cultures that can quickly adapt to industry changes, as well as patient needs. We have been serving communities across the beautiful and adventurous state of Oregon for over 50 years! And we are pioneers and thought leaders in the industry. Our commitment to innovative and operational excellence has allowed us to create healthcare solutions that are both cost\-efficient and cutting edge. Come see how healthcare is done right!


**General Physical Requirements**



Manual dexterity for office machine operation including computer and calculator; stooping, bending to handle files and supplies, mobility to complete errands for deliveries, or sitting for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Stress can be triggered by multiple staff demands and deadlines.
